Street images: six university campuses in China, Baidu street view (© Baidu). Task from Lin, Liu & Sun (2026), Buildings 16, 1623, doi:10.3390/buildings16081623.

config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views (pitch 20°) in and around six of the eleven supplementary campuses in Lin, Liu & Sun (2026, Buildings): Peking University, Tsinghua University, Southeast University, Wuhan University, Xiamen University and Tianjin University, not the paper's images. As in the paper's campus paired-comparison task, participants see two campus street views and choose the one that looks safer, livelier or more beautiful. The paper's 49 participants (students, staff and staff family members) produced 10,705 comparisons per dimension for 2,141 images, used with Place Pulse 2.0 to train campus perception models. Differences from the original study: (1) 10 pairs per dimension per participant, pairs drawn from all six campuses; (2) the campus sampling areas were drawn by us, so some views show streets next to the campus; (3) role on campus is recorded.

paper.title: Explainable Vision Analytics for Adaptive Campus Design: Diagnosing Multi-Dimensional Perceptual Differences
